components.name: Departure Card
components.description: The recurring transport summary with route, destination, and dominant countdown.
components.css: .ds-departure-card { display:grid; grid-template-columns:4px auto 1fr auto; gap:10px; align-items:center; padding:10px 14px 10px 0; border:1px solid var(--border, rgba(0,0,0,.08)); border-radius:12px; background:var(--surface,#fff); color:var(--text,#171717); font-family:'Satoshi','DM Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-accent-bar { align-self:stretch; border-radius:0 2px 2px 0; background:var(--accent,#171717); } .ds-route,.ds-countdown { font-family:'Neue Machina',sans-serif; font-weight:900; } .ds-route { font-size:19px; } .ds-destination { min-width:0; font-size:15px; } .ds-countdown { font-size:34px; line-height:1; letter-spacing:-1.5px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid primary call to action for a deliberate user choice.
components.css: .ds-primary-button { padding:14px 24px; border:0; border-radius:12px; background:var(--accent,#171717); color:var(--text-on-accent,#fff); font:600 15px 'Satoshi','DM Sans',sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 120ms ease,opacity 120ms ease; } .ds-primary-button:hover { transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-primary-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#171717); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-primary-button:active { transform:scale(.965); opacity:.9; }

components.name: Page Header
components.description: Route title with compact circular page navigation.
components.html: Arbete
components.css: .ds-page-header { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-top)) 20px 0; background:var(--bg,#fafaf9); } .ds-page-header h1 { flex:1; margin:0; color:var(--accent,#171717); font:800 clamp(38px,10vw,52px)/.9 'Neue Machina',sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.035em; text-align:center; } .ds-nav { width:36px; height:36px; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:var(--accent-subtle,rgba(23,23,23,.1)); color:var(--accent,#171717); cursor:pointer; transition:transform 120ms ease; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#171717); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-nav:active { transform:scale(.92); }

components.name: Station Notice Bar
components.css: .ds-notice { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; width:100%; padding:9px 12px; border:1px solid var(--border,rgba(0,0,0,.08)); border-radius:10px; background:var(--surface,#fff); color:var(--text-secondary,rgba(0,0,0,.55)); font:600 12px/1.3 'Satoshi','DM Sans',sans-serif; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; } .ds-notice span:first-child { flex:1; } .ds-notice b { padding:1px 6px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--accent,#171717); color:var(--text-on-accent,#fff); font-size:11px; } .ds-notice:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#171717); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Disruption Pill
components.description: Small severity tag used only with affected transit information.
components.css: .ds-disruption-pill { display:inline-flex; padding:2px 7px; border-radius:10px; background:var(--accent,#171717); color:var(--text-on-accent,#fff); font:700 9px/1 'Satoshi','DM Sans',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase; }

narrative.overview: Nästa is a real-time Stockholm transit dashboard designed for a single purpose: telling the commuter when the next departure leaves, in under a second, at a glance. It takes the visual language of physical departure boards at transit stations — bold, typographic, high-contrast, no decoration — and brings it to a mobile screen. The system is opinionatedly flat: no gradient text, no glassmorphism, no numbered section markers, no decorative flourishes. Surfaces separate by borders and tonal contrast, not by shadows. The interface at 480px max-width is always a single column, one-handed, designed for outdoor sunlight readability and tunnel-region offline resilience.
keyCharacteristics: No gradient text, side-stripe borders, glassmorphism, or decorative flourishes.
Mobile-first, single-column interface at 480px maximum width.
A bold countdown is the dominant numeric element on departure cards.
Handcrafted light, dark, and system palettes use purposeful status color.
Surfaces separate through borders and tonal contrast; shadows signal floating elements.

rules.name: The Static Token Rule
rules.body: Every production token belongs to the small Light/Dark palette tables and has a concrete use in the app.

rules.name: The Dominant Countdown Rule
rules.body: The departure countdown is the largest number on any card; secondary times remain small and below it.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow is always a deliberate signal that an element floats above the content stack.

dos: Do make the departure countdown the dominant visual element on a card.
Do use the handcrafted semantic Light/Dark tokens and validate contrast.
Do keep the app single-column, mobile-first, and centered on the primary scroll flow.
Do use border strokes for card separation and static semantic tokens for transit status.
Do honor reduced-motion preferences and show data freshness.
donts: Don't use gradient text, decorative side-stripe borders, or generic card grids.
Don't use decorative glass on cards or panels.
Don't combine a card border with a large blurred drop shadow.
Don't create numbered section markers or uppercase tracked kickers without a real sequence.
Don't hardcode undeclared status colors or use a radius larger than the established scale.
